groups.passage: America encourages its young people to drink. [[21]], our society makes drinking a part of every celebration. Our personal celebrations, [[22]] weddings, promotions, graduations, and anniversaries, are [[23]] linked with drinking. [[24]] children can attend any family affair without seeing the adults enjoying their liquor. Drinking is part of our national celebrations as well. The Fourth of July means beer and New Year's Eve is an entire night dedicated to the proposition that everyone must get [[25]]. Secondly, the shows young people watch on television encourage them to drink. On [[26]] every soap opera, the characters drink casually and often. The rock videos young people watch over and over again feature alcohol, too. [[27]] on the videos sit in bars, nightclubs, and roadhouses. Drinking, the message goes, is cool. The strongest encouragement to drink that young people receive, [[28]], comes from advertisers. Beer companies often sponsor the sports events young people watch. In addition, advertisements for liquor, on TV and in print, show situations that are [[29]] to the young. People hoist their glasses [[30]] they are sitting around ski lodges, sailing, dancing, or enjoying a football game. We may say we don't want our children to drink, but our messages say just the opposite.

sections.title: 四、閱讀測驗
sections.instructions: 說明：第41至50題，每題請分別根據各篇文章選出最適當的一個選項，標示在答案卡之「選擇題答案區」。每題答對得2分，答錯不倒扣。

groups.passage:
Breaking into the computer codes (known as 'hacking') of banks, large companies or even government departments is the latest game for super-intelligent teenagers. One young hacker said, "Hacking is just intellectual. It's your brain against the computer. It's like climbing Mount Everest—it's something you have to do. You don't even need a very expensive computer—but you must understand everything about all kinds of computers."
At the moment most of these games are just fun for young people. But how long will it be before criminal gangs, like the Mafia, start to use computer experts to help them in their crimes? Future bank robbers will not need explosives to blow open bank safes—all they will need is someone who can break computer codes. Already in Britain people say that computer crimes are costing companies between 500 million pounds and 2.5 billion pounds a year.

groups.passage: There is increasing scientific evidence that large cars cause more highway accidents than small cars. In the news recently was the story of a woman who died of a heart attack while driving her station wagon. The car was moving so fast that it went through the highway-dividing fence, resulting in a collision in which five people died. Those unnecessary deaths are attributable in part to the woman's choice of a large automobile. A lighter and smaller car probably wouldn't have gone through the fence, its remaining energy would have been much less, and this would have reduced the chances of serious injury or death. Because of its small size, it might have missed the other car completely. The present design of the oversized automobile is largely responsible not only for increasing death toll on the highways but also for the rapid depletion of our resources of petroleum, for the pollution of our environment, and for the congestion and inconvenience of our cities.

groups.passage:
Three pilot whales are believed to be swimming freely off the Atlantic Coast today. Their names are Tag, Notch, and Baby. These seagoing mammals are among the lucky survivors of a whale-stranding last December at Cape Cod.
As many as 60 pilot whales swam ashore. Scientists are still trying to find out why whales have this self-destructive behavior. Many of the whales died on the beach—crushed by their own weight. Whale experts found Tag, Notch, Baby alive. The three were believed to be too young to survive on their own of returned to sea.
The three whales were taken in a van to the New England Aquarium in Boston, Mass. They were kept in a 60,000-gallon tank for seven months. Only a few people worked with the whales so that they would not become too accustomed to human beings.
Early this past summer the three whales were pronounced fit enough to be returned to the Atlantic Ocean. A month after their release, the whales were spotted. They were found in a group of 50 whales about 60 miles from where they had seen set free.

options.B: a behavior currently unknown to scientists.
options.C: a genetic phenomenon currently being studied by whale experts.

questions.stem: The pilot whales died on the beaches of Cape Cod due to

options.A: the lack of salt water to facilitate their respiration.
options.B: the lack of nutrition to maintain their enormous body weight.
options.C: their body structure unable to support their body weight out of water.
options.D: a phenomenon yet to be figured out by scientists.

questions.stem: The three whales Tag, Notch, and Baby were rescued because

options.B: amongst the many whales found beached, these three were deemed the healthiest.
options.C: they were alive when the rescue team found them.
options.D: the rescue crew liked them very much.

options.C: Pilot Whales are mammals that can become used to human beings.
options.D: After their release, Tag, Notch, and Baby were never seen again.

sections.title: 二、英文作文
sections.instructions: 說明：依提示在「答案卷」上寫一封100至150字的信。評分標準：內容5分，組織5分，文法4分，用字拼字4分，體例（格式、標點、大小寫）2分。

figures.caption: 回信上下款格式（提示2「依下列方式寫出」的方框）
figures.description: 方框內示範回信的上下款：右上角為日期「February 20, 1995」；左側稱呼語「Dear George:」；其下為第一段信文，以5行虛線表示（首行縮排）；接著3個上下排列的圓點，表示中間省略的信文；再接最後一段信文，以5行虛線表示（首行縮排，末行較短）；右下方為結尾敬辭「Your friend,」，下一行為署名「Chih-ping」（斜體）。

questions.stem:

2. 回信的上下款應依下列方式寫出。

advice for a foreign pen pal coming to live in Taiwan

extraction.method: 官方 Word 版（paper-2.doc → soffice 轉 docx → python-docx）取文字，並以 run 的底線屬性核對每個空格位置、斜體屬性核對舞台說明；與 pdftotext -layout 題本逐段比對；以 Read 逐頁檢視題本 PDF 影像（8 頁，含封面）確認版面、段落、斜體／底線與作文提示中的回信格式方框；答案檔為五科合併的掃描檔（無文字層），以 pdftoppm 200dpi 轉圖、裁切英文欄放大，用 Read 看影像逐題抄錄，再以整頁影像複核。；查證（verifier）：答案檔第1頁以 200dpi 重新轉圖、裁切英文欄（1–30、31–50 兩欄）逐題核對 50 題答案（含第45題「B或C」，並看第2頁確認只有社會、自然）；以 python 將全部 50 題的選項（200 個）、題幹、各大題說明、9 篇選文／對話（含 [[題號]] 位置）、中譯英 5 句與作文提示，分別和 Word 版（python-docx）及 pdftotext -layout 逐詞比對，全部一致；以 Read 逐頁看題本 PDF 影像（第2–8頁）複核段落數、空格位置與作文回信格式方框（另由 docx 內嵌圖放大確認「Dear George:」為冒號）。
issues: 答案來源：answer.pdf（units.json 標 quality "none"）為無文字層的掃描檔，標題「八十四學年度大學入學考試中心學科能力測驗參考答案」，第1頁為國文、英文、數學合併答案表，第2頁為社會、自然；以 pdftoppm 200dpi 轉圖並裁切英文欄，用 Read 看影像逐題抄錄第1–50題，再以 100dpi 整頁影像複核一次（確認抄的是「英文」欄）。
第45題官方答案為「B或C」（兩者皆給分）：answer 填答案檔先列的 B，accepted_answers 填 ["C"]，scoring_notes 逐字記「答案檔原文：「B或C」」。統計分析或判分時須把 B、C 都視為正確。

無統計與評分原則：units.json 中84學年度只有題本 PDF、Word 版與選擇題答案，沒有 stats（答對率／鑑別度／選項分析）與 scoring 檔，所有小題 stats 為 null，sources.scoring／stats 為空陣列（validator「整份考卷沒有任何統計資料」warning 屬實）。中譯英第1–5題大考中心未公布參考譯文，answer／accepted_answers／scoring_notes 填 null；作文 answer 依 schema 為 null，作文評分標準（內容5、組織5、文法4、用字拼字4、體例2）印在題本說明中，已逐字放在 s6.instructions。

結構核對：gsat-spec.json legacy_gsat 83–87 期別只有粗略描述（「84與85選擇題50題」、非選擇題兩大題），與本卷封面「選擇題共50題／非選擇題共兩大題」一致。本卷實際結構：第一部分 單一選擇題—一、對話 1–10（每題1分，10分）、二、詞彙 11–20（每題1分，10分）、三、綜合測驗 21–40（每題1分，20分）、四、閱讀測驗 41–50（每題2分，20分）；第二部分 非選擇題—一、中譯英 5句×4分（20分）、二、英文作文（20分）；合計100分，考試時間100分鐘（封面）。各大題標題題本沒有印配分，title 照原文不加；points_total 依說明文字「每題答對得1分／2分」「每句4分」計算，作文20分依評分標準5+5+4+4+2加總。

「一、對話」（第1–10題）：四則對話（1–3、4–5、6–8、9–10題為題組），對話中挖空、每空各有4個選項，結構與綜合測驗相同，因此 section.type 標為 cloze（title 保留「一、對話」以便與一般綜合測驗區分），每則對話為一個 group，passage 逐行保留說話者與斜體舞台說明（如「(Julia and May are sitting on the sofa talking.)」「(twenty minutes later)」），空格寫成 [[題號]]。這類題目不屬於詞彙／文法，tags 只標 test_point（多為 discourse），answer_pos 一律省略。

題本原文疑誤，逐字保留：(1) 第31–40題選文「rafting down the Rogue River [[32]]. swimming in the Applegate River」空格後多一個句點（依文意與答案 D or 應無句點），PDF 與 Word 版相同。(2) 第47–50題選文「Whale experts found Tag, Notch, Baby alive.」缺 and；「too young to survive on their own of returned to sea」的 of 應為 or；「about 60 miles from where they had seen set free」的 seen 應為 been。(3) 第50題 (C)「Pilot Whales」W 大寫。(4) 第6題 (C)「he's not come yet」、第42題 (D)「soon to replace coding bank safes」、第46題 (B)「derives from scientific evidence」照原文。(5) 中譯英第5句句末無句號（「我覺得我做了一件有意義的事」），照原文。
中譯英：題本為五個各自編號的中文句子（內容連貫成一則小故事，非短文挖空），每句一題；題號 1.–5. 與選擇題第1–5題重號，依 gsat-85／86 慣例 no 保留 1–5、label 為「中譯英1」–「中譯英5」；作文題本未編號，no 填 1、label 為「作文」。validator 的「題號重複 [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]」warning 因此產生，屬合理。

英文作文：題型為回信（essay_type=letter），說明要求「寫一封100至150字的信」，word_requirement 記為「100至150字」，未規定段數故 paragraphs 省略。stem 收錄「提示：」及其兩點內容（逐字，英文問句的直引號照原文）；提示2所指的回信上下款格式方框是圖片（Word 版亦為內嵌圖），已在 figures 以文字完整描述（日期 February 20, 1995、稱呼 Dear George:、首段與末段虛線、中間三個圓點表示省略、結尾 Your friend, 與斜體署名 Chih-ping），rows 為 null。

文字來源與正規化：以官方 Word 版為主要文字來源，與 pdftotext -layout 及題本 PDF 影像逐段比對，三者文字一致。pdftotext 把第31–40題選文末行「some of which offer good food and gorgeous views.」因左右對齊拆成逐字母、把「[[33]] ,」拆到兩行，皆以 Word 版與影像確認。句間兩個空白一律改為一個；詞彙題空格一律寫成 ______（前後各一空格、標點前不留空格）；第1–3、4–5、6–8、9–10、21–30、31–40、41–43、44–46、47–50「題為題組」標題為題本中的分組標示，以 group 呈現，未另存文字。斜體（舞台說明、署名）不保留格式。

標註：第24題（Few children ...）、第35題（a number of）的正確選項為限定詞／冠詞，schema 無此詞類，未填 answer_pos。第34題 For those who ... 的 test_point 以介系詞語意（as for）標為 word_meaning。閱讀第50題為「NOT true」題，依其他年度慣例標 detail。各題組 sdgs 依主題判斷：飲酒（3）、電腦犯罪（16）、大型車的交通死亡與耗油污染壅塞（3、11、12）、領航鯨擱淺救援（14），其餘為空陣列。
